subject: basic-computing
title: Introduction to E-services
meta: Lesson practice set · Question types of the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: Practice set for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.q: What is the importance of SWAYAM portal?
questions.answer: It ensures equity and quality in education by giving courses (school to post-graduate) with content, video and quizzes anytime and anywhere.

questions.q: Radhika is appearing for 10th Board exam under CBSE. Under which E-service will she get her digitally signed documents? Write the URL.
questions.answer: DigiLocker; https://digilocker.gov.in

questions.q: What is Passport Seva?
questions.answer: An online service of the Ministry of External Affairs for applying for and renewing passports and booking appointments.

questions.q: Which RBI service allows transfer of any amount from anywhere to anywhere? Name it and describe briefly.
questions.answer: NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer): an electronic funds transfer system that needs the beneficiary's account number, name and IFSC code.

questions.q: What is UPI?
questions.answer: Unified Payment Interface, a unique identifier used by banks to transfer money and make payments using IMPS.

questions.q: Briefly describe the National Portal of India.
questions.answer: A single-window portal (india.gov.in) giving access to all E-services of the Indian government.

questions.q: What is the aim and use of the E-service whose URL is www.irctc.co.in?
questions.answer: IRCTC is used for booking and cancelling railway tickets, checking seat availability, train timings, tracking and e-catering.

questions.q: Describe UMANG App.
questions.answer: A mobile app of the Government of India that gives single-window access to Central, State and local government services.

questions.q: What are the benefits of E-services?
questions.answer: Greater reach, transparency, convenience, timely delivery and cost saving.

questions.q: What does ORS stand for?
questions.answer: Online Registration System.

questions.q: What does IFSC stand for?
questions.answer: Indian Financial System Code.

questions.q: Expand NDLI.
questions.answer: National Digital Library of India.

questions.q: Expand NROER.
questions.answer: National Repository of Open Educational Resources.

questions.q: What is an E-service?
questions.answer: Any service that can be availed electronically, usually through the internet.

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: What is DigiLocker? Write any two benefits.
questions.answer: DigiLocker lets us store scanned documents online and access them anytime and anywhere. Benefits: documents can be shared online; they are issued directly by registered issuers so authenticity is easy to validate; eSign works like self-attestation.

questions.q: What are the components of an E-service?
questions.answer: The service provider, the service receiver and the channels of service delivery, mostly the internet.

questions.q: How does an E-service help the service provider?
questions.answer: It saves cost of infrastructure, staff, transport and paperwork, allows speedy delivery and easy expansion of services.

questions.q: How can E-services benefit the end user?
questions.answer: The user gets services at a click from anywhere, saves time and travel, enjoys transparency and timely delivery.

questions.q: List the government initiated E-services in the field of education.
questions.answer: SWAYAM, NROER, National Digital Library of India (NDLI) and DigiLocker for certificates.

questions.q: What is NEFT and what details are needed to use it?
questions.answer: A system by the Reserve Bank of India to transfer money electronically; the beneficiary's account number, name and the IFSC code of the branch are needed.

questions.q: What is the difference between NEFT and UPI/IMPS?
questions.answer: NEFT is a bank-to-bank electronic transfer with the IFSC; UPI uses a unique id with IMPS, which is faster than NEFT and works 24 x 7.

questions.q: What is the Online Registration System (ORS)?
questions.answer: A framework linking hospitals so that patients can book appointments online using an Aadhaar-based registration; AIIMS uses it.

questions.q: Write any four services provided by IRCTC.
questions.answer: Booking and cancelling rail tickets, seat availability, train timings and tracking, e-catering, air ticket booking.

questions.q: What is NDLI?
questions.answer: The National Digital Library of India, a portal that integrates digital libraries, with material from primary to post-graduate level in over 70 languages.

questions.q: Explain the 'Know India' section of the National Portal of India.
questions.answer: It has authentic information about the country such as places to visit, tour operators, power and energy and foreign affairs.

questions.q: What are the e-services provided by educational institutions?
questions.answer: Filling application forms, viewing admit cards, downloading study material and viewing results.

sections.title: Answer the questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: Explain any three government initiated E-services.
questions.answer: National Portal gives single-window access to government services; Passport Seva provides online passport application and renewal; DigiLocker stores digital documents; UMANG app provides government services on a phone.

questions.q: Explain the benefits of E-services.
questions.answer: Greater reach to remote areas, access for diverse users, transparency, convenient access, timely delivery, cost saving and easy expansion.

questions.q: Explain SWAYAM, NROER and NDLI.
questions.answer: SWAYAM offers courses with content and quizzes for all levels; NROER is a repository of open educational resources under Creative Commons; NDLI integrates digital libraries with study material in more than 70 languages.

questions.q: Explain NEFT, IMPS and UPI.
questions.answer: NEFT is the RBI's electronic fund transfer needing account details and IFSC; IMPS transfers money immediately round the clock; UPI is a unique identifier used with IMPS for payments.

questions.q: Explain the Online Registration System and the Online Ticketing System.
questions.answer: ORS lets patients book hospital appointments online using Aadhaar and gives a UHID; IRCTC allows booking and cancelling of train and air tickets, 24/7 support, train tracking and e-catering.

questions.q: Explain DigiLocker and the benefit of its eSign facility.
questions.answer: DigiLocker keeps scanned copies of important documents accessible anytime; eSign lets us digitally sign self-uploaded documents like self-attestation; issuers' documents are authentic and shareable.
